pages.text: The $(thing)Glass Press$() turns hot TFC glass batches into finished products with a reusable mold. It does not heat glass by itself; use $(l:tfc:mechanics/heating)Heating$() first.
The press is unlocked at the wrought iron stage. Steel sheets can also be used in place of wrought iron sheets.

pages.title: Pressing
pages.text: 1. Heat a $(l:tfc:mechanics/glassworking)Glass Batch$() until it reaches at least $(4)$(bold)Faint Red$().$(br)2. Put the hot batch in the input slot.$(br)3. Put a mold in the mold slot.$(br)4. Take the result from the output slot.

pages.title: Output
pages.text: Each pressing recipe consumes one hot glass batch and uses the installed mold shape.
